aetherium.option.advanced.conflict_auto_: Hand features back to a conflicting mod instead of double-applying them.
Enable dev-level logging (hot-path cost: near zero when off).
aetherium.option.advanced.experimental_c: Experimental, Minecraft 1.16.5 only: Aetherium's own terrain pipeline. Solid and cutout chunks are stored in a compact vertex format (a quarter smaller than vanilla's), grouped by face direction so faces pointing away from you are never sent to the GPU, and drawn with Aetherium's own shader. Translucent blocks stay vanilla. Switching it rebuilds the loaded chunks once; it turns itself off and falls back to vanilla if anything fails.
aetherium.option.advanced.pipeline_shade: How the Aetherium pipeline draws. On: Aetherium's own shader with compact vertices (fastest). Off: compatible mode, which keeps vanilla's vertex format and vanilla's own draw calls and only skips the faces pointing away from you, for graphics drivers and GL translators the shader crashes on. Switched off automatically if shader mode crashed the game.
aetherium.option.advanced.stutter_log.to: Write every frame that takes far longer than usual to logs/aetherium-stutter.log, with what happened in that frame (packets, chunk uploads, builds, garbage collection). Written on a background thread; at most 1 MB.
aetherium.option.android.battery_fps_cap: Frame-rate cap used by battery saver.
aetherium.option.android.battery_saver.t: Cap the frame rate to save battery.
aetherium.option.android.enabled.tooltip: Enable launcher/renderer probing. No-op on desktop.
Override the detected renderer; use when the launcher env is unreadable.
aetherium.option.android.memory_budget_m: Heap budget reported for the device; auto-detected from cgroup limits.
aetherium.option.android.read_custom_env: Parse the launcher's custom_env.txt for renderer hints.
aetherium.option.android.thermal_ceiling: Hottest CPU/GPU temperature at which the thermal guard engages.
aetherium.option.android.thermal_guard.t: Android only, opt-in: cap the frame rate at 30 while the phone is above the thermal ceiling. The temperature is read on a background thread.
aetherium.option.android.touch_mode.tool: Taller rows and larger hit targets in the Aetherium screen.
Dropped luminous items, burning entities and blazes emit light.
Torches and other luminous items held by players and mobs emit light.

Light emitted by held items and entities: hold a torch and the blocks around you light up. FAST updates 4x per second with a shorter radius; FANCY updates every tick. Takes effect immediately, no restart; Off costs nothing.
aetherium.option.effects.freelook.third_: Switch to the third-person camera while freelooking from first person, so you can see around your player. Off keeps the first-person view.
aetherium.option.effects.freelook.toggle: Press Freelook once to look around and again to stop, instead of holding it.
aetherium.option.effects.fullbright.tool: Override the brightness so caves and nights are fully lit.
Use the smooth cinematic camera while zoomed, for steady aiming at long range.
aetherium.option.effects.zoom.default.to: How far the Zoom key zooms in when pressed, in percent. 50 is about four times, like OptiFine. Change it while zooming with the scroll wheel or the Zoom In / Zoom Out keys (rebind them in Options > Controls).
aetherium.option.effects.zoom.min_fov.to: Field of view at full zoom, in degrees. Lower = stronger maximum zoom.
While zooming, the scroll wheel zooms in and out instead of changing the hotbar slot.
aetherium.option.effects.zoom.sensitivit: Mouse sensitivity is lowered while zoomed, but never below this percentage of normal. 100 = unchanged.
aetherium.option.effects.zoom.smoothness: Zoom changes are animated over this many milliseconds. 0 = instant.
aetherium.option.effects.zoom.speed.tool: How fast the scroll wheel and the Zoom In / Zoom Out keys change the zoom.
aetherium.option.effects.zoom.third_pers: Third person: the zoom keys move the camera between 0.5 blocks and this distance instead of zooming. 0 = zoom the field of view in third person too.
Third person: the Zoom key toggles the camera distance instead of being held.
aetherium.option.effects.zoom.toggle.too: First person: press Zoom once to zoom and again to stop, instead of holding it.
aetherium.option.general.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. true = OpenGL 3.0 backend (Aetherium hooks active), false = Vanilla. Live, no restart.
aetherium.option.general.hud.corner.tool: Overlay anchor: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right.
aetherium.option.general.notify_conflict: Log and show a notice when a conflicting mod is present.
aetherium.option.general.preset.tooltip: Last applied performance preset; any manual change turns it back into CUSTOM.
aetherium.option.general.ui.dark_mode.to: Dark theme for the Aetherium settings screen.
aetherium.option.general.ui.sounds.toolt: Interface sounds in the Aetherium settings screen.
aetherium.option.performance.adaptive_di: Lower the render distance by one chunk after FPS stays under the target for 10 seconds, raise it after 30 seconds of headroom. Every change reloads all chunks, so it waits 30 seconds between changes.
aetherium.option.performance.adaptive_ta: FPS the adaptive render distance tries to hold.
aetherium.option.performance.animated_te: Animate water, lava, fire, portals and other animated block textures. Off skips every animation texture upload, a large saving on mobile GL layers.
aetherium.option.performance.block_entit: Chests, signs, banners, heads and other block entities farther than this many blocks are not drawn (64 = vanilla; beacon beams are exempt).
aetherium.option.performance.coalesce_re: While terrain loads, every chunk section is marked for rebuilding again each time a neighbouring chunk or its light arrives. Wait until a far or new section has been quiet for a moment, then build it once instead of up to ten times. Sections you edit, and built sections within 28 blocks, are never delayed.
aetherium.option.performance.entity_cull: Entities farther than this many blocks are not rendered.
Skip rendering entities beyond the cull distance (bosses, vehicles and the camera entity are exempt).
aetherium.option.performance.occlusion_c: Skip entities hidden behind terrain, using the chunk visibility vanilla already computes for blocks. Players, named and glowing entities are never hidden.
aetherium.option.performance.particle_de: Percentage of spawned particles that are kept.
aetherium.option.performance.smooth_chun: Spread finished chunk meshes over several frames instead of uploading them all in one frame, which removes the stutter while chunks load or generate.
aetherium.option.performance.smooth_stre: Spread the work of arriving chunks over several frames: incoming chunk, light and entity packets get a time budget per frame instead of all being processed in one frame, and chunk meshes are converted for the GPU on the worker threads. Removes the big frame drops when walking or flying into unloaded terrain.
aetherium.option.performance.threaded_ch: Rebuild changed chunks near you on the worker threads instead of freezing the frame (vanilla 1.16.5 rebuilds everything within 28 blocks on the render thread). Blocks you place or break still update instantly. Also spreads client light updates over frames. The biggest fix for stutter while chunks load and while walking with dynamic lights.
aetherium.option.performance.worker_thre: Threads for world generation. 0 = automatic (vanilla on desktop; on Android half the cores minus one, between 2 and 4, so the render and server threads are not starved). Chunk meshes are built on Aetherium's own threads. Applies after a restart.
See a few blocks further while inside lava.
aetherium.option.quality.fog.distance.to: Fog that hides the edge of the render distance. Off shows terrain all the way to the edge (also removes the thick Nether fog). Fog under water, in lava and from blindness is unaffected.
aetherium.option.quality.fog.start.toolt: Where the distance fog begins, in percent of the render distance. 75 = vanilla; higher keeps more of the world clear.
aetherium.option.quality.fog.water.toolt: Density of the fog under water, in percent. 100 = vanilla, 0 = clear water.
aetherium.option.quality.particles.ambie: Floating ambient particles: Nether ash and spores, mycelium and the underwater haze.
aetherium.option.quality.particles.block: Fragments when blocks are broken, and the chips while mining one.
aetherium.option.quality.particles.comba: Critical and enchanted hit stars, sweep attacks and damage hearts.
aetherium.option.quality.particles.drips: Dripping water, lava, honey and tears; bubbles and underwater particles.
Torch and fire flames, soul flames and lava pops.
aetherium.option.quality.particles.porta: Nether portal, ender pearl and ender chest particles.
aetherium.option.quality.particles.potio: Potion swirls and splash effects, beacon and conduit effects.
aetherium.option.quality.particles.smoke: Smoke, campfire smoke, clouds and poof particles.
aetherium.option.quality.particles.totem: The burst from a Totem of Undying.
aetherium.option.quality.particles.weath: Raindrop splashes on the ground and in water.
aetherium.option.quality.sky.cloud_heigh: Height of the cloud layer in blocks. 0 = the dimension's own height (128 in the Overworld).
aetherium.option.quality.sky.sky.tooltip: Draw the sky dome, sunrise colours, sun, moon and stars. Off leaves a flat sky colour (cheapest).
aetherium.option.quality.sky.sun_moon.to: Draw the sun, the moon and the sunrise and sunset glow.
aetherium.option.quality.weather.tooltip: Render rain and snow. Off saves a lot of fill rate on mobile GPUs.
